name: VIN Cube 3x3 Nova (Magnetic, MagLev, Ball-Core, UV Coated)
description: The VIN Cube 3x3 Nova (Magnetic, MagLev, Ball-Core, UV Coated) is a premium, competition-focused magnetic speed cube built for solvers who want fast turning and dependable control. It combines MagLev for a quicker, lower-resistance feel, a ball-core for stronger corner-to-core stability, and a high-grip UV coated exterior that stays clean and resists scratches.
features: Faster, cleaner turning: MagLev reduces spring friction for a more responsive feel.
More stability at high TPS: Ball-core corner-to-core magnets improve control and re-alignment.
Stronger, more decisive magnet feel: Aerospace-grade purple titanium magnets provide up to 1.7× stronger absorption force than ordinary magnets.
Easy to tune: Tool-free dual adjustment with defined settings makes dialing in your feel quick and repeatable.
Premium grip and durability: UV coating adds high grip, resists scratches, and helps prevent lube buildup.
35° auto-alignment: Helps the cube snap into place for smoother transitions and fewer lockups.
